description: Mounting/Construction Rules UI - Designer can configure mounting types (DIRECT/PROFILE/COVE) per template lighting entry, with gap values and structure requirements displayed per spec section 55.
steps: Create directory frontend/src/components/MountingRules/ with files: MountingRulesPanel.tsx, AddMountingRuleDialog.tsx, index.ts, and __tests__/ directory.

In MountingRulesPanel.tsx: Follow the exact pattern from HiddenComponentsPanel.tsx. Accept templateId prop. Check CanvasMode.DESIGNER to hide in consultant mode. Fetch from 'template_lighting' table using fromTable('template_lighting').select('*').eq('template_id', templateId). Display each lighting entry showing: sku_id, edge_selection, mounting_type (with color-coded badge like trigger-type badges), and computed gap/structure info based on mounting_type: DIRECT (gap=0mm, no structure required), PROFILE (gap=0mm, no structure required), COVE (gap=10mm, structure required). Include an 'Add Mounting Rule' button that opens the dialog. Use data-testid='mounting-rules-panel', data-testid='add-mounting-rule-btn', data-testid='no-mounting-rules-msg', data-testid='mounting-rule-item-{id}', data-testid='mounting-type-{id}'.

In AddMountingRuleDialog.tsx: Follow AddHiddenComponentDialog pattern. Fields: SKU ID (text input), Edge Selection (text input), Mounting Type (select: DIRECT, PROFILE, COVE). Show computed info panel below the mounting type select showing gap_mm and structure_required based on selection. Insert into 'template_lighting' table. Use data-testid='add-mounting-rule-dialog', data-testid='sku-id-input', data-testid='edge-selection-input', data-testid='mounting-type-select', data-testid='gap-info', data-testid='structure-info', data-testid='confirm-btn', data-testid='cancel-btn'.
In index.ts: Export MountingRulesPanel and AddMountingRuleDialog.

Create __tests__/MountingRulesPanel.test.tsx following HiddenComponentsPanel.test.tsx pattern. Mock fromTable to return sample lighting data with all 3 mounting types. Test: renders in DESIGNER mode, hidden in CONSULTANT mode, displays items after fetch, shows correct mounting type badges, shows correct gap/structure info for each type, shows empty state, opens dialog on button click. Minimum 8 test cases.
acceptance_criteria: MountingRulesPanel renders in DESIGNER mode and is hidden in CONSULTANT mode
Panel fetches and displays template_lighting entries with sku_id, edge_selection, mounting_type
Gap and structure info is correctly computed and displayed: DIRECT(0mm,no), PROFILE(0mm,no), COVE(10mm,yes)
Add button opens AddMountingRuleDialog which allows creating new entries
Dialog inserts into template_lighting table with correct fields
All new tests pass along with existing 673 tests
TypeScript strict mode passes with no errors
verification: cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx vitest --run src/components/MountingRules/__tests__/
cd frontend && unset NODE_OPTIONS && npx tsc --noEmit
